title: Amelia | Summer shirt with artistic print
bodyHtml:
Light, breathable and a dream against the skin, this is the shirt that instantly pulls an outfit together. The refined artistic print in harmonious tones delivers that effortless chic factor that just works—whether you're heading to the shops or catching up with friends. The fluid drape skims your shape without clinging, and long sleeves roll up or stay down depending on your mood and the warmth of the day.

Why you'll love it

  • Artistic print that elevates even the simplest trousers—feels like a boutique find
  • Breathable and airy, designed to keep you comfortable on warm days
  • Skimming fit that follows your shape without clinging or pulling tight
  • Versatile sleeves—wear them long for cool mornings, roll them up as the day warms
  • Effortless elegance that works from the office to weekend catchups
  • Natural drape that just moves with you, all day long
  • That "I've got it sorted" look without trying at all
